items.root_cause: a scheduled task created by a session writes its SKILL.md outside the repo and nothing mirrors or exempts it at creation; the daily sync only refreshes EXISTING mirrors (deliberately, since ops/prompt-backup is in a public repo and a new SKILL may carry personal data), so every new task pages 24h later until someone hand-mirrors or exempts it

root_fix.what: decide each new SKILL at creation or on first sight: mirror it when it carries no personal markers, else require an EXEMPT entry, instead of waiting for the 24h page
root_fix.exact_change: reviewer to design: e.g. -SyncMirror gains an add-new path gated by the same exemption list, or task creation writes the mirror; not settled in this cheap pass

prevention.what: the sync that runs daily from capture-run.ps1 handles NEW scheduled-task SKILLs, not only existing mirrors
prevention.exact_change: reviewer to design (see root_fix); the three current SKILLs are the fixture

proof.must_fire_case: MUST FIRE: a new scheduled-task SKILL with no mirror and no exemption, older than 24h, fails the daily run (as ff-flyer-gold-day-2, link-rides-7-build-check, recall-cluster-rulings did 2026-09-29)
proof.clean_twin: CLEAN TWIN: the same SKILL after the sync mirrors it (or an EXEMPT entry names it) passes, and an EXEMPT personal SKILL is never written into the public mirror

blast_radius.risk: a public-repo leak if a personal SKILL is auto-mirrored; the exemption list is the guard

items.root_cause: Three detectors find the same class of question (does this product belong to this commodity?) and write three files nobody reads: coverage-gaps.json, semantic-findings.json, aisle-test.json. The resolver scripts exist (explain-coverage-gap, apply-coverage-batch, add-known-wrong) but no lane consumes the findings and no ledger remembers a decision, so an undecided finding is re-paged whenever any member of its set changes (signature de-dup over the whole set). Measured: 0 of the 21 actionable gaps and 0 of the 3 semantic rows carry a recorded decision today, and 9 of the 21 are live wrong-product ROUTINGS (a claimer commodity holding a product that is not its food) that the page has described as 'a store dropped' for weeks.

root_fix.what: one worklist and one verdict ledger for all three detectors; the daily chain merges and decides, the weekly unattended lane applies decided rule changes through apply-coverage-batch in gated batches, and the three alert types page only NEW undecided keys under -Lane weekly
root_fix.exact_change: (1) match-worklist-lib.ps1: Read-MatchFindings returns one row per kind|commodity|store|name from coverage-gaps.json (actionable only), semantic-findings.json (coverage rows) and aisle-test.json (BLOCK rows), each with the detector's own evidence (reason, claimer, cos/score, dept). Merge-MatchWorklist keeps first_seen/last_seen, drops a key the detector no longer reports, and skips any key in match-verdicts.json. (2) resolve-match-worklist.ps1 runs in the daily chain after the three detectors (fan-out lane, marker MATCH-WORKLIST-COMPLETE scanned= decided= undecided= new=): it classifies each undecided key as release (the claimer is not the product's food), widen (no rule admits the product's own food), confirm (the claim or refusal is right: written to match-verdicts.json at once), ad-line (the name offers two or more products), or undecided; the classifier is the sidecar identity score of product-vs-target against product-vs-claimer AND a head-noun check, and it DECIDES only when both agree. It writes grocery/out/match-worklist.json and never edits a rule. (3) apply-coverage-batch.ps1 -FromWorklist <n>: takes the n oldest release/widen keys, derives the release exclude or the widened pattern, runs its existing gates (routing, gate 2b from batch 2, its revert), and records each outcome (applied, reverted with the gate's reason, ruled known-wrong through add-known-wrong.ps1) in match-verdicts.json keyed as the worklist is. (4) check-ad-cycles.ps1: the three alert blocks read match-worklist.json and page, through Send-AlertConditions -Lane weekly, only keys whose first_seen is today and that are still undecided; the body lists them with the lane's classification and no command. (5) audit-coverage-gaps.ps1 carries the worklist's first_seen into coverage-gaps.json so the daily REVIEW line says how old each gap is. (6) alert-registry.json: semantic-sweep, stores-dropped and wrong-department resolver 'digest' -> 'lane:grocery/resolve-match-worklist.ps1', in the same commit. ACCEPTANCE BAR, written before the classifier is built: over the 24 frozen labels in the evidence (21 gaps + 3 semantic rows), 0 wrong decisions among the keys the classifier decides, with coverage printed beside it (decided of 24). If the bar is not met, the lane ships DOCKET-ONLY: it decides nothing, writes every key with its evidence, and the weekly lane (an unattended agent, lane:grocery/triage-due.ps1) adjudicates from the docket.

prevention.what: the emitting check stops re-paging a question already answered and stops handing the answer to a person: a decided key is written to match-verdicts.json and never pages again, an undecided key pages once (its first day), and the applier consumes the worklist instead of a person reading a body
prevention.exact_change: audit-coverage-gaps.ps1 and the two sibling detectors' alert blocks in check-ad-cycles.ps1 read their finding set through Merge-MatchWorklist (verdict-ledger filter, first_seen); the whole-set signature files coverage-gap-alert.sig, semantic-alert.sig and aisle-alert.sig retire; apply-coverage-batch.ps1 gains -FromWorklist; as in root_fix

items.root_cause: A commodity registration and the recipe vocabulary that names the same food are two records written by two tools on two days, and nothing compares them when either lands. run-gates runs audit-ingredient-identity only as -SelfTest; its data pass runs once a day inside check-ad-cycles; apply-coverage-batch.ps1, new-commodity.ps1 and add-commodity-rule.ps1 never read db/ingredients.json. So 4880ebc98 could land three commodities that claim three vocabulary names, the rebid was deferred to another queue id (9b0825), and the next chain paged the gap as three NEW findings. Measured over the 61 commodities.json commits of the last 30 days: 10 vocabulary rows changed route in 6 commits, 4 of them newly off their bid (4880ebc98 x3, 828d5226b 'Cooked White Rice' rice -> unrouted). The split in this item is exactly such a change (Pepperoncini moves banana-peppers -> pepperoncini), which is why its rebid must ride the same push.

root_fix.what: audit-ingredient-identity.ps1 -RoutesOnly (Get-IdentityRouteChanges in ingredient-identity-lib.ps1): check (a) only, per (item, bid) pair against the mark's proxy|/unrouted| keys; on-bid -> off-bid, unrouted -> proxy and proxy -> another id REFUSE (exit 2 with the rebid command), proxy -> unrouted SPEAKS, exit 3 on unreadable input or no mark, never writes the mark. Wrapper meal-prep/pipeline/audit-ingredient-routes.ps1 (Invoke-NativeScript, declared gate-inputs) entered in run-gates $static.
